poolHints.triage: Checks each new card and the entire backlog once a day: queue it, ask owner, or defer

poolHints.nocode: Executes no-code tasks: research, instructions, texts, service setup. Steps for human — as owner question, result — to 'Approvals'
poolHints.tester: Checks submitted work: tests, stand, screenshots — 'tested' or return
poolHints.deployer: Deploys tested work, always one at a time
